This is why deterministic checks around model behavior are so important, and why we need to solve alignment. To explicate the scenario: Wikipedia (for example) has a policy that all scripted clients must identify themselves via User-Agent contact email. A user asks Claude to research something on Wikipedia. Resultantly, Claude sends the user's email to Wikipedia in its curl call. Anyhow, the privacy mod is now source available , so folks can see what the check is that prevents this model behavior.
